 "content": "def transform(g):
    # Pattern is a 3x5 tile in upper left; tile's non-background cells are copied
    # centered at every isolated marker of the marker color.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    # determine tile: 3x5 pattern, located at input upper-left in demo 3 rows 12-14 cols 0-4
    # generalize by extracting contiguous non-background patch containing multiple colors
    coords=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    # keyed pattern: find dense small multicolor component, extract bounding box
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in coords:
      if p in seen: continue
      q=[p]; seen.add(p); comp=[]
      while q:
        r,c=q.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
          t=(r+dr,c+dc)
          if t in coords and t not in seen: seen.add(t);q.append(t)
      comps.append(comp)
    key=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in key); r1=max(r for r,c in key); c0=min(c for r,c in key); c1=max(c for r,c in key)
    pat=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # markers are singleton objects, at cells of the distinctive scattered marker color
    marker=max(set(g[r][c] for r,c in coords),key=lambda x:sum(v==x for row in g for v in row))
    # Actually marker is color that appears outside key, typically 6/3; based on component
    for r,c in coords:
      if r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1: continue
      if g[r][c]==marker:
        for i in range(len(pat)):
          for j in range(len(pat[0])):
            rr=r+i-1; cc=c+j-2
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and pat[i][j]!=bg: out[rr][cc]=pat[i][j]
    return out
